Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a separately designed pixel-art TITLE SIGN for the Grenoble Bomber game menu, delivered as ONE tightly framed transparent PNG. Not a screenshot or a complete webpage.
Style reference images show the existing game's coarse pixel art, blue police uniform, black hooded protester, teal bins and orange traffic cones. Match their clear square-pixel clusters, muted French-Alpine palette with warm terracotta, cream, teal and dark navy. Charming lighthearted slapstick, friendly cartoony expressions.
The object is a beautifully hand-crafted flat FRONT-FACING WOODEN SIGN with stepped pixel corners and dark navy pixel outline, warm honey-colored wood planks, visible chunky wood grain, a few nail heads and small comic decorations. Broad horizontal composition about3:1 width:height. Big readable CUSTOM PIXEL LETTERING fills the sign; the words are the main subject, not tiny text. Letters have blocky cream faces, warm rust-red/gold accents and a dark3D pixel shadow, carefully spaced and hand-designed. Keep all lettering comfortably inside frame and exact.
TRUE transparent background outside the sign and its small attached decorations. No white rectangle, checkerboard, drop-shadow haze, scene, ground, additional captions, watermark, UI buttons or fake small lettering. Pixel art, no vector-smooth curves, gradients or photorealism.
Exact title text (two compact lines): first "GRENOBLE", second "BOMBER". Make BOMBER the bolder larger word, cream and orange-red against honey wood. A tiny blue police helmet perched crooked on the top-left corner, one small dark round cartoon bomb tucked at the lower-right corner, its short fuse shaped like an exaggerated comic curl. Small snowy-mountain notch on the top edge subtly recalls Grenoble. Funny but elegantly composed; title is instantly readable.
